contract: Original local Orbit storefront: browse categories, add sample products, adjust/remove/clear cart, reload on localhost and download a local text summary. Native dialog and progressive CSS animation; no order/payment service or personal data. Target 1440x1000 and 390x844, additional 320 and breakpoint checks.

accessibility.evidence: Pointer and keyboard flows exercised: named native dialog contains Tab focus, Escape closes and restores trigger focus, quantity buttons have names, live updates are inside the dialog, disabled controls reflect empty/quantity limits. Small gray text retains the previously checked contrast fix. Basic browser check only; no real screen reader test.

responsive.evidence: No document overflow in exact browser viewports 1440x1000, 390x844, 320x740, 767x900 and 768x900; text computed sizes doubled at 390 without page overflow. Mobile cart, rail controls and Thai labels visually inspected.

loading.reason: Fixed local catalog and synchronous local scripts; no asynchronous backend or remote data loading.

empty.evidence: Clearing the cart shows empty guidance and disables clear/download controls; native modal stays operable.

error.evidence: Corrupt saved JSON shows recovery message. Denied localStorage shows explicit persistence limitation while an in-session product/cart total still works.

partial.reason: Fixed four-product catalog is complete for this demo; two intentionally empty categories have explicit empty messages, no partially loaded data.

success.evidence: Two phones plus buds total 63700; quantity changes, reload, real summary-file download, remove and clear all passed. Normal entrance and panel animation plus hover transform observed; reduced motion disables animation and transition.

permission.reason: No login, account, external integration or permission request. Storage denial is handled as a recoverable local error.

renderedEvidence.observation: Rendered storefront retains original Orbit style and exposes cart in navigation.
Rendered Thai mobile storefront shows horizontal category/product rails with less vertical gap.
Native cart panel shows sample line quantities, 63700 total and download action.
Mobile cart is readable, has named close control and local-summary note.
